attackers_goals: An attacker is attempting to gain access to an account secured with MFA.
description: An abnormally high amount of authentication attempts via universal authentication were seen within a short period of time. This may indicate a brute-force attack.
investigative_actions: Check the legitimacy of this activity and determine whether it is malicious or not. Check if the user usually logs in from this country. Check whether a successful login was made after unsuccessful attempts.
